mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT gr.review_id AS reviewId, gr.goods_id AS goodsId, gr.user_id AS userId, u.username AS nickname, IFNULL(u.avatar, '') AS avatar, gr.rating AS rating, gr.content AS content, DATE_FORMAT(gr.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM goods_review gr LEFT JOIN users u ON gr.user_id = u.user_id WHERE gr.goods_id = #{goodsId} ORDER BY gr.create_time DESC
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(num), 0) FROM orders WHERE goods_id = #{goodsId} AND status IN ('待付款', '待发货', '待收货')
